risk_summary: The disclosure is substantially quantified and provides clear year-over-year performance and credit-quality metrics, but relies on non-GAAP “Underlying” measures that may present a more favorable view than GAAP results. Risk indicators include declining net interest income and profitability, higher retail and commercial net charge-offs, and continued office and multifamily CRE stress, although criticized balances declined and most CRE loans remained current.
